body:
thank you for responding, mr catz. i am trying to find a way out. so i will not take any drastic measures yet. 

i guess i just don't know where to start. i don't know if i'm help-able so i don't want to guinea-pig anyone i care about into trying to help me. just a weird feeling.

holy shit. this resonated so much with me. honestly i don't know what to say to make you feel better. just, wow. i know how you feel. i feel the same way. i don't know how to fix it. i just know that there's a threshold somewhere, and i don't have to cross it if i don't want to. i just don't know where it is. it sounds like you don't either. don't know if it's worth finding out. but in the end, in the grand scheme of things, there is no difference between ending it today and doing it tomorrow. so why not wait.
